cards.name: Eclipse Observer Maya

coverage_override.reason: The paired ATK/DEF modifiers implement one continuous printed effect, followed by two independently activated effects; the shared HOPT clause is merged into those activated effects.

effects.printed_clause: Gains 300 ATK/DEF for each card in your opponent's hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A single-range EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK on the Monster Zone returns opponent hand count times 300, and a clone applies the same computed value as EFFECT_UPDATE_DEFENSE.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Omega computes a continuous hand-size-derived value with Duel.GetFieldGroupCount and applies cloned EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK and EFFECT_UPDATE_DEFENSE registrations.

effects.printed_clause: (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; Set 1 "Eclipse" Quick-Play Spell from your hand. It can be activated this turn. You can only use this effect of "Eclipse Observer Maya" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: After discarding Maya, the Quick Effect now Sets a custom Eclipse Quick-Play Spell, Book of Eclipse, or Book of Lunar Eclipse from the hand and grants EFFECT_QP_ACT_IN_SET_TURN after a successful Set. AddCodeList/listed_names contains both official IDs.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Omega discards the handler for a Quick Effect, Sets one specifically qualified Quick-Play Spell, and grants EFFECT_QP_ACT_IN_SET_TURN to that Set card.
The official Omega DB and script identify Book of Lunar Eclipse as an Eclipse-named Quick-Play Spell that the printed name pool includes.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: Book of Lunar Eclipse (31834488) was missing from Maya's hand Set pool.

effects.printed_clause: If your opponent draws 2 or more cards at the same time: You can Special Summon this card from your GY. You can only use this effect of "Eclipse Observer Maya" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed EVENT_DRAW trigger in the GY checks the opponent drew at least two cards in the event, then validates an open zone, Necrovalley, and self-summon legality before Special Summoning the related handler under a distinct HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Omega registers an EVENT_DRAW trigger while the handler is in the GY and Special Summons after validating event conditions, relation, and an open Monster Zone.
Official Omega derives the drawing player and number of simultaneously drawn cards from EVENT_DRAW's ep and event group.

cards.audit_note: Added Book of Lunar Eclipse consistently to Maya's metadata and hand Set filter.
